notes: Summary: Mid-market product analytics vendor evaluating Redwood for doc-search + support routing. Started on Hosted API; moving toward Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost.
POC details: 2-week POC using hosted_api. Dataset = 500k docs, embedding index + reranking pipeline + chat assistant for support agents.
Performance goals: target p95 latency <150ms for short chat queries, throughput target ~150-250 QPS during peak. Current hosted API p95 ~180-220ms on baseline config.
Cost sensitivity: high. Finance asked for unit economics analysis and TCO vs self-host. Requested cost optimization workshop to get concrete levers to reduce per-token cost.
- Recommended batching: enable adaptive batching for embedding bulk loads; expected 2x throughput improvement on test corpus.
- KV/prefix caching: identified common prompt prefixes for support flows; cache hit rate could cut token use by ~18%.

- Quantization profile: perf eng recommended int8/q4_0 for majority of reranking/embedding use; suggested q4_8 for chat where quality needs preservation. Estimated 35-50% cost reduction for non-chat workloads.
- Routing policy: propose hybrid routing (hosted for low-volume dev + dedicated for peak). Auto-fallback to lower-cost model variants when capacity constrained.
- Unit economics: built example model-level unit cost table during workshop; showed break-even for Dedicated at ~100k tokens/day given their usage patterns.
Customer quotes: 'We like the batching and quant recommendations — gives us a path to bring costs in line with budget.'
Open technical notes: network/VPC egress limits, need explicit peering guide for Dedicated, timeline for on-prem option (they flagged not needed now but asked about future).
Security & compliance: require SSO (SAML), SOC2 evidence (provided), KMS integration for key management in Dedicated, data residency US-only. Legal wants retention controls documented.
Commercial: Requested itemized Dedicated pricing with burst capacity options and committed-usage tiers. Finance asked for 3-year TCO scenario vs cloud self-host.
Next steps agreed: Redwood to send refined Dedicated quote + TCO worksheet, schedule security deep-dive w/ infra team, demo of autoscaling & burst behavior in Dedicated env.
